Author: Mysterious Popoto
Name: GPoseStudio
Description: Captures the GPose frame and applies GPoseStudio color/lighting looks. Cosmetic, client-side only. Works alongside Brio/Ktisis.
Changelog:
0.8.0 - Looks travel: a look is stored inside exported PNGs, so an image can be imported later to recover it. Import and export a look as a file. First-run help on the Looks tab.
0.7.2 - 89 unit tests, and a release that refuses to publish over a failing suite.
0.7.1 - Look files are written atomically and validated; the config carries a schema version so migrations are keyed to it rather than guessed from array lengths.
0.7.0 - Undo, partial look loading, clipping warnings, a cast ground shadow and a final grade over the composite. Fixed a stale depth view that could turn the frame black.
